summary: Full SaaS iteration test (backend + frontend). Backend: 20/20 pytest tests passed against the public URL — auth (signup/login/wrong-password/me), multi-tenant isolation (2 fresh accounts each see only their own 4 seeded patients, disjoint IDs), stats scoping, /scribe/soap protection (401 without token, 200 with), /scribe/save signed_by=user name and appears in patient detail, /ai/discharge share=true creates token, /api/discharge/public/{token} works with no auth AND returns clinic branding (name, primary_color, footer, content), PATCH /clinic persists (name/color/onboarded), /audit lists soap_signed + ai_discharge + discharge_shared + clinic_updated + export_*, /export/patients.csv has correct headers and 4 rows, /export/notes.csv works, /api/plans public returns 3 plans with expected lookup_keys, amounts (4900/19900/49900) and trial_period_days=14, /payments/checkout returns a Stripe checkout URL. Frontend: Landing renders brand + Sign-in + Start-free-trial + 'Every appointment' heading. /pricing shows 3 plan cards with plan-{lookup_key} and plan-cta-{lookup_key} testids and 'Most popular' badge. /faq renders 9 accordion items. /demo submits and shows success state. /signup creates account and redirects to /onboarding; 3-step wizard runs (name → color+footer → finish) and lands on /app. Trial banner shows '14 days left in trial'. /app/billing shows current plan ('Vetaura trial' / 'trialing' / '14 days left in trial'), all 3 billing-plan-{key} + billing-cta-{key} cards render. /app/settings renders and saves clinic branding; export buttons present. /app/discharge Draft-&-share generated a share token successfully; opened /d/{token} in a NEW no-auth browser context — public portal loads with clinic branding, medications, warning signs, and 'Request recheck' button. /app protected route redirects unauthenticated visitors to /login. Audit log page shows AI draft, share, and clinic-update entries with human-readable labels. Existing vet1@example.com onboarded flag is false in DB so login lands on /onboarding (expected given ProtectedRoute gate).

ui_bugs.issue: Feature cards were missing data-testid (fixed inline — added data-testid=\"feature-{i}\" to each of the 10 cards).

action_items: None blocking. Optional: consider redirecting existing accounts whose onboarded flag was set false (vet1/vet2) into /app directly by setting onboarded=true in seed, so re-testing login flow doesn't land on /onboarding.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py load_dotenv runs before importing stripe_service — good.
auth.py stores emails lowercase; API layer email comparisons should always .lower() (tests already normalise).
stripe checkout uses subscription_data.trial_period_days=14 correctly; free trial without card enforced by not requiring payment method.
Multi-tenant isolation is enforced by clinic_id filters on every query in server.py — verified with 2 fresh accounts having fully disjoint patient IDs.
discharge_shares docs are public via token — token is uuid4().hex (128 bits), acceptable entropy.
startup() legacy backfill only assigns docs without clinic_id to 'demo' — this is safe but should be removed once legacy data is out.

success_rate.frontend: 100% (all critical flows verified: landing, pricing, features, faq, demo, signup, onboarding, dashboard, billing, settings, discharge, audit, owner portal, protected redirect)

test_credentials: vet1@example.com / strongpass123 (existing, onboarded=false), vet2@example.com / strongpass123 (existing). Fresh accounts created per test run with TEST_ prefixed emails.
seed_data_creation: Each signup auto-seeds 4 demo patients per new clinic. Test run created 2 fresh accounts (TEST_A_*, TEST_B_*) + 1 UI-flow account (ui_*) + 1 demo request.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend regression tests are in /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py — run with `python -m pytest /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py -v -o 'addopts=' --junitxml=/app/test_reports/pytest/pytest_results.xml`. The default pytest.ini uses -n auto (xdist) which splits fixtures across workers and breaks the audit-log fixture chain — override with `-o 'addopts='` to run serially. Stripe checkout in browser was NOT completed (per instructions) — backend test verified the checkout URL is a stripe.com URL and pricing/billing pages verified via DOM testids. Owner portal /d/:token was verified in a fresh browser context with zero auth cookies.
